course_outcomes: Explain core machine learning concepts, paradigms, and workflows.
Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis using Python.
Implement supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms using Scikit-Learn.
Evaluate and optimize model performance using appropriate metrics and cross-validation techniques.

modules.module_title: Introduction to Machine Learning & Python Ecosystem
topics: Overview of Machine Learning: Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning
Setting up the Python Environment (Jupyter Notebooks, Google Colab)
Introduction to key libraries: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Scikit-Learn
learning_outcomes: Differentiate between supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning paradigms.
Set up a Python environment for data science and machine learning.
Load and inspect datasets using Pandas and NumPy.
suggested_resources: Python Data Science Handbook by Jake VanderPlas (Chapters 2 & 3)

topics: Categorical data encoding (One-Hot Encoding, Label Encoding)
Splitting data into training and testing sets
learning_outcomes: Clean raw datasets and handle missing values appropriately.
Transform categorical data and scale numerical features for model compatibility.
Apply train-test splits to avoid data leakage.

topics: Cost Functions and Gradient Descent intuition
Evaluating Regression Models: MAE, MSE, RMSE, and R-squared
learning_outcomes: Understand the mathematical foundation of Linear Regression.
Train and predict using Linear Regression models in Python.
Select and compute appropriate performance metrics for regression tasks.
suggested_resources: StatQuest: Linear Regression Series on YouTube
Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras, and TensorFlow (Chapter 4)

topics: Evaluation Metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score
learning_outcomes: Build classification models using Logistic Regression and Decision Trees.
Interpret confusion matrices to evaluate model performance.
Choose proper evaluation metrics for balanced and imbalanced datasets.
suggested_resources: Machine Learning by Andrew Ng (Coursera - Classification Modules)

topics: Hyperparameter Tuning using GridSearchCV and RandomizedSearchCV
learning_outcomes: Diagnose model bias and variance issues.
Perform K-Fold Cross-Validation to assess model generalization.
Optimize hyperparameters to improve model performance.
suggested_resources: Scikit-Learn Documentation on Tuning the Hyperparameters of an Estimator
An Introduction to Statistical Learning (Chapter 5: Resampling Methods)

topics: Structuring an End-to-End Machine Learning Project
learning_outcomes: Implement K-Means clustering to discover patterns in unlabeled data.
Understand the concept of dimensionality reduction.
Assemble a full ML pipeline from data loading to evaluation.

project_ideas: Predicting Housing Prices: Build and evaluate a linear regression pipeline to estimate house sales prices based on features like area, location, and rooms.
Customer Churn Prediction: Develop a binary classification model (Logistic Regression / Decision Tree) to predict whether a telecom customer will churn.
Iris Flower Species Classification: Apply EDA, model training, and performance visualization using the classic Iris dataset.
E-commerce Customer Segmentation: Group shoppers into behavioral clusters using K-Means clustering based on purchasing history.
